notes_for_editor: Read the FFLOS register page (location Tempest Knob, Plymouth County; register number US 28, MA 28) and the pin list PDF (names Tempest Knob for Wareham). Three FFA Massachusetts and Wareham Historical Society Facebook posts appeared in search snippets only (login-walled, not opened, nothing quoted from them). Those snippets say the tower was a municipal tower, active until 1945 and then abandoned, shown abandoned in 2009, and removed in 2015 to 2016 during construction. If a readable source confirms these, the fate and status would change, so a human should check a newspaper or town report. The register's 'run by the local fire company' and the snippets' 'municipal' may both be true. A Wareham Historical Society snippet mentions a Tempest Knob postcard 'on Oak Street', which may point to a different spot; low priority, since the register and pin list agree. Story is short because the register is the only detailed page read. Record kind 'tower', material 'wood' and status 'gone' match the register; no correction proposed.
